account: It is day 0, just after 09:00. I came from home to town hall and read the appointment book. Today calls for office correspondence, a 10:00 market walk in the plaza, lunch at home, town accounts at 13:00, tea with the neighbour at an east-bank dockside cottage at 15:00, office at 16:30, and home at 19:00. Several townsfolk have passed near town hall, but I have seen nothing unusual in their actions. The secretary has arrived carrying a writable book and asks why the appointments chest is empty and what engagements to arrange. That is explained by my having taken the appointment book to read it; I still carry it. I asked about correspondence and local news but have not yet received any substantive news. Although I have a feeling something may be happening without my knowledge, I currently have no evidence of a hidden gathering, scheme, or unusual activity, nor grounds to identify anyone involved or its purpose.
